reports.question_bank_provides_search_an: Question bank provides search and filters; Reports provides accuracy, errors, trends, timing, and evidence; Admin manages models, imports, transfers, and test-data cleanup.
reports.regular_practice_supports_daily_: Regular practice supports daily learning and question debugging. You can submit multiple answers and optional reasoning, which becomes learning-analysis evidence.
reports.regular_practice_shows_the_revie: Regular practice shows the review summary, confidence, and safe feedback. Strict tests save only the judgment, with no answers, missing items, or hints.
reports.ai_review_overrides_grading_only: AI review overrides grading only with sufficient evidence that a format limitation caused a misgrade. Otherwise rule-based grading remains or the answer awaits review.
reports.repeated_errors_can_trigger_a_te: Repeated errors can trigger a temporary hint question based on the original question, answer, and reasoning, independently reviewed before use. It is not added to the bank or report statistics.
reports.view_answer_immediately_locks_th: View answer immediately locks the question and disables submission. Explain solution can clarify the already-shown method; explanations enter the evidence timeline.
reports.report_missing_diagrams_garbled_: Report missing diagrams, garbled text, unclear vertical arithmetic, recurring-decimal marks, contradictory conditions, or unclear wording.
reports.select_up_to_500_questions_acros: Select up to 500 questions across pages for review practice. Bulk retirement requires a dynamic confirmation code and preserves historical evidence.
reports.ai_repair_suggestions_use_the_qu: AI repair suggestions use the question, answer specification, impact statistics, review queue, and recent evidence, and require administrator approval. Mock mode is the default; disable it for real AI calls.
reports.retired_questions_leave_future_p: Retired questions leave future practice/test pools. Reports, evidence timelines, and old sessions can still trace the original question.
reports.the_batch_summary_shows_availabl: The batch summary shows available and unfinished questions, quality tier, remaining generation/review call limits, and aggregated failure reasons.
reports.historical_batches_can_be_reopen: Historical batches can be reopened, synced for practice, or used to generate a batch report.
reports.expand_metric_details_to_inspect: Expand Metric details to inspect definitions, filters, exclusions, update time, numerator/denominator, sample size, and confidence.
reports.the_evidence_timeline_orders_sub: The evidence timeline orders submissions, help, hint questions, solution reveals, retries, concerns, and replacements chronologically.
reports.ai_reports_receive_the_time_wind: AI reports receive the time window, filters, report type, and evidence IDs rather than being asked to invent missing database facts.
reports.sparse_data_or_weak_evidence_sho: Sparse data or weak evidence should be flagged. Each conclusion should trace through evidence_id to original submissions and events.
reports.it_covers_star_calibration_mathe: It covers star calibration, mathematical correctness, elementary methods, duplicate attacks, injection protection, formatting, answer review, report faithfulness, and cost/performance.
reports.the_prompt_panel_handles_activat: The prompt panel handles activation and rollback. The quality suite supplies traceable acceptance evidence before and after changes.
reports.clear_history_resets_report_data: Clear history resets report data for testing and requires a one-time dynamic confirmation code. Expired or reused codes fail.

reports.report_summaries_are_calculated_: Report summaries are calculated from submissions and answer events. Refresh the report after regrading to see updated results.
reports.exported_reports_remain_historic: Exported reports remain historical snapshots. Export a new report if this question changes its conclusions.
reports.report_data_could_not_be_loaded_: Report data could not be loaded. Use Check again or Refresh all.
reports.uses_the_final_submission_for_ea: Uses the final submission for each session-question pair. AI review supplies grading evidence without revealing answers.
reports.session_reports_use_current_subm: Session reports use current submissions; repair-related regrades are marked in evidence.regrade.
